explorer.title: Connections
explorer.label: Connections and databases
explorer.emptyBody: Add a MongoDB server with its connection string. Passwords are stored in your system keychain.
explorer.localhostMissing: No MongoDB server answered on localhost:27017.
explorer.exported: Saved to {{path}}. Passwords are not included.

profile.uriCopied: Connection string copied, without the password.

dialog.description: Paste the connection string from your provider, or fill in the form.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.connectionStringHint: If it contains a password, odin-db moves it to your keychain.
dialog.passwordSaved: Saved in keychain. Leave empty to keep it.
dialog.readOnlyHint: Blocks every change to data from odin-db. Recommended for production.
dialog.connectionStringRequired: Enter a connection string, for example mongodb://localhost:27017.
dialog.colorHint: Shown in the sidebar, on tabs and above every collection, so you always know where you are.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The connection and its saved password are removed from this computer. Your data on the server is not affected.

create.databaseDescription: MongoDB creates a database together with its first collection.

rename.title: Rename {{name}}
rename.description: Documents, indexes and options are kept. Applications using the old name stop finding it.
rename.name: New name

drop.collectionBody: The collection {{namespace}} is permanently deleted with all its documents and indexes.
drop.viewBody: The view {{namespace}} is deleted. The collections it reads from are not affected.
drop.databaseBody: The database {{name}} is permanently deleted with all its collections, documents and indexes.

health.lost: {{name}} stopped answering. odin-db keeps retrying in the background.

form.unsupported: This connection string can't be shown as a form. Edit it in the Connection string tab.
form.srvHint: For Atlas and other clusters published through DNS.
form.allowInvalidWarning: Anyone on the network could intercept this connection. Use only for local testing.
form.directConnectionHint: Connect to this host only, without discovering the rest of a replica set.

ssh.enableHint: For servers reachable only from a bastion host. The connection string then names the server as the bastion sees it.
ssh.passphraseOptional: Only if the key is encrypted
ssh.secretSaved: Saved in the system keychain. Leave empty to keep it.
ssh.limits: Through a tunnel odin-db connects directly to one server: SRV (mongodb+srv) addresses and replica set discovery are not available.

hostKey.changedTitle: The SSH server's key has changed
hostKey.unknownBody: This is the first connection to {{host}} for {{name}}. Check that the fingerprint below is the server's (ask its administrator if unsure), then trust it. It will be checked on every connection.
hostKey.changedBody: {{host}} now presents a different key than the one trusted for {{name}}. If the server was not reinstalled or rekeyed, someone may be intercepting the connection: do not continue.
hostKey.unknownShort: First connection to this server: check the fingerprint before trusting it.
hostKey.changedShort: A different key than the one trusted before. Continue only if you know why it changed.
hostKey.changedConfirm: I know why the key changed and I trust the new one.
hostKey.trustNewAndTest: Trust the new key and test
